name: csv-export-guard
title: CSV Export Guard
description: Stops spreadsheets silently corrupting an export by previewing what each column opens as (phone numbers and PIN codes losing leading zeros or their +, long IDs becoming 1.23457E+15, "3-4" turning into a date, cells starting with = + - @ running as formulas) and offering a per-column fix that forces text or neutralises the formula.
